system.description:
Your strength is drawn from harmony and connection, every bond you forge is weaving power into a Chorus the whole group can wield. You gain a resource called Echo. Your maximum Echo capacity is equal to your Tier. At character creation you start with maximum Echo:

  • Whenever an ally within Close range wants to Help an Ally and they succeed this action roll, gain an Echo.

  • Whenever an ally within Close range initiates a Tag Team Roll and they succeed, gain an Echo.

When an ally within Close range Utilizes an Experience, you can spend an Echo instead of the Hope the ally would have spent. If you do, the ally can use an Experience from another ally within Close range instead of one of their own.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v1.0 Heart

system.gmNotes: Gaining Echo from allies' Help an Ally and Tag Team successes is not automated: raise this resource by hand.
